messages:
Priya: thanks for joining the all-hands earlier — starting a tiny thread to capture follow-ups re: customer wins/losses. keep entries short, pls.
AllHandsBot: slides + recording: https://redwood.app/ah/2141008888 (auto-upload) :film_projector:
Evan: top-line: buyers repeatedly ask for a single-page compliance packet and a hands-on perf demo they can run. leadership wants us to decide which of those we can deliver this quarter.
Jonah: Sales feedback: two deals slipped because procurement wanted a "deploy & test" guide to validate residency and audit logs. They asked for step-by-step test cases, not just claims.
Nia: CS: customers also asked for a migration "smoke test" checklist— basic queries to run post-migrate to confirm behavior + perf baseline. wants it packaged as a 1-pager.
Marco: Sales ops: can we assemble a "POC demo kit" (terraform + sample workloads + perf harness) so prospects can self-run POCs we previously did in-house? would cut cycle time.
Hana: Product: we can create a POC kit but need to limit surface area. propose: (a) quickstart terraform for private deployment, (b) perf harness with configs for 3 workload patterns, (c) sample compliance packet.
Chris: Eng-runtime: for perf harness, we can provide a small benchmarking script and a docker image that hits our endpoints with realistic token distributions. will need security review for sample keys.
Sam: Legal note: the "one-page compliance packet" must be vetted but we can create a redacted template (no real certs) and a checklist of attestation items.
Priya: concrete asks to owners please (max 3). we'll prioritize in the product sync tomorrow.
Evan: leadership asks: 1) POC demo kit (self-serve) 2) One-page compliance summary + attestation checklist 3) Public-facing migration smoke tests.
Jonah: Sales asks: 1) deploy & test test-cases doc, 2) 48h RFP bundle we can attach when responding.
Nia: CS asks: 1) migration smoke-test 1-pager, 2) rollback expectations + typical outage window guidance.
Marco: I'm volunteering Sales to help craft the 48h RFP bundle and will drop templates to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/sales/rfps/2141008888
Hana: Product volunteers: me + Chris for the POC kit. can we get a small lab env for the demo harness?
Chris: Eng can seed a tiny lab with a few quantized model variants. need cloud creds and a naming convention.
Sam: Legal will prepare a template compliance packet and a "what we can say" doc for Sales.
Priya: thanks all. action plan: Product to own the POC kit (Hana, Chris), Legal to prepare compliance template (Sam), Sales to assemble 48h RFP bundle (Marco, Jonah), CS to draft smoke-tests (Nia). I'll circulate owners + timeline by EOD. add any other signals here. :sparkles:
